author: BmB
body:
On the xp board there should be a section where you can see the Avicus Network's stats. This means all xp on the server earned combined, all kills and deaths added up, KD and pvp KD. It also needs to have a daily and weekly part with targets, nemesis and what gamemode earns the most xp etc... It is just something added into the leaderboards that is everything earned on avicus. I think it would be really interesting to see this and it should be fairly simple to make. 

P.S: I didn't really know where to post this topic since the suggestion section of the forum is gone. *Cough* Add it back *Cough*.

replies.body: No luca think about it every kill there is a death so the overall pvp k/d would be 1 exactly.
